prediction_text: Failure and dishonour: this last western expedition will end badly for Essex — no success or honour, with loss of substance/support and surrender/capture or ruinous defeat at the hands of enemies. Saturn lord of Ascendant peregrine and in fall in 2nd, Dragon's Tail in Ascendant, Moon in detriment separating from Saturn trine and applying to square Mars (lord 2nd/9th), Fortune disposed by lord of 7th (enemies). Time window: within this expedition, by the Moon-Mars square's campaign phase (weeks to a few months in 1644).
basis: Event horary: lord Asc peregrine/fall in 2nd, Cauda in Asc, Moon detriment to square Mars, Fortune under enemy lord = defeat/loss, enemies profit.
